1) 75% of patients with chordoma or chondrosaroma of the base of the skull and cervical spine who recur do so at doses less than the prescribed doses, 2) the most probable cause for recurrence is the dose limitation of normal tissue, and 3) the dose limitations are most likely to be in regions where the tumor volume is greater than 75 cm3
(1) 75% of recurrences occurred in regions where tumor doses were limited by normal tissue dose constraints; and (2) 25% of recurrences were in regions receiving the prescribed dose.
